t: A credit card sized mini computer that plugs into a monitor and keyboard.
steps: Buy the Fruit Jam from Adafruit for about 40 US dollars or from a reseller such as The Pi Hut.
Gather a USB-C cable, a monitor with a video cable, and a USB keyboard.
Download the latest CircuitPython file for Fruit Jam from the CircuitPython website.
Double-click the reset button and drag the file onto the drive that appears.
Install the free Mu editor on your computer.
Open the Adafruit Learn guide and try the blink example with the onboard lights.
Set up Wi-Fi first and the sound chip second. Resetting the Wi-Fi chip clears the sound setup.
Try the Apple IIe or Mac Classic project guide next.
